messages:
sahil: Quick follow-up on the postmortem for the DB failure — can we align on customer-facing comms? Specifically: status page wording, a short incident summary for customers, and the policy for sharing the full RCA. Who can own each?

emily: I can own the status page wording + customer email draft. Will post proposed copy by EOD tomorrow. :+1:

aj: Ops note — we should be careful with the severity language. Given ~10% error rate during the window I'd go with 'partial outage' not just 'degraded'. I'll provide a short mitigation timeline to include.

maria: Legal here — please avoid definitive root-cause statements until internal RCA signoff. Share high-level cause + concrete impact numbers (customers affected, time window). Full technical RCA should be sent to customers only after legal + eng signoff. Also add the standard disclaimer: "We are investigating and will notify if the scope changes."

nate: Product suggestion — include a "what we're doing next" bullet list on the status page update (eg: immediate mitigation, monitoring changes, longer-term fixes) and call out whether customers should or should not take any action.

dylan: Eng-SRE update — I'm already tracking recurring instances of increased DB contention. Proposed immediate action items:
- Change circuit-breaker thresholds to fail fast (owner: dylan) due: 2024-11-12
- Add synthetic health checks targeting tail latency (owner: aj) due: 2024-11-15
- Attach instrumentation to correlate KV cache misses with CPU (owner: dylan) due: 2024-11-18
- Postmortem doc update with timeline and preventative plan (owner: sahil) due: 2024-11-10

emily: Draft status page copy (will iterate, pls review):

```
Status: Partial outage — We observed elevated error rates for token-generation requests in US-West between 2024-11-05 18:12 UTC and 2024-11-05 18:34 UTC. A subset of requests (~10%) experienced errors or timeouts.
Impact: Some users experienced failed requests or increased latency. No data loss.
What we're doing: We implemented an immediate mitigation to reduce load on the affected DB shard, deployed a temporary configuration to route traffic away from the hotspot, and are adding additional monitoring to detect recurrence.
Next steps: We'll perform a root cause analysis and share a customer-friendly summary once internal review is complete. Customers with SLA impacts will be contacted directly.
```

sahil: That looks good. Two notes: 1) Maria — please review copy for the legal/phrasing constraints. 2) Nate — add the short "should/can" action guidance if needed.

ops-bot: Follow-up checklist created: INC-FOLLOWUP-1740504321. Assigned to: emily,dylan,aj,sahil.

emily: I'll send the customer email draft to @sahil and @maria for review by 2024-11-10 COB. Also will prepare a shorter incident summary for the status page and a slightly expanded one for customers who opted into technical updates.

aj: For recurring incidents tracking, propose tagging related incidents with #recurring-db-contention and producing a weekly digest. I'll own aggregation and initial dashboard (due 2024-11-20).

dylan: Also adding an alert that triggers when KV cache miss rate + DB CPU exceed threshold for 5m — will reduce noisy, manual reviews. Owner: dylan (due 2024-11-14).

sahil: Quick ownership recap: emily — status page + customer email; dylan — circuit breaker, alerts, instrumentation; aj — synthetic tests + weekly digest; maria — legal signoff; me (sahil) — final postmortem doc update and publishing policy. We'll reconvene after emily posts copy. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
